COMPONENT_SET.detail: This is the question this lane was asked to answer, and the answer is that the gap is real. The Colorado Judicial Department publishes JDF 491, 'Guide to Sealing Non-Conviction Records (simplified process)', at revision R: August 7, 2024 — the same revision date as both bound forms. Its step 2, headed 'File the Request — File these forms into your criminal case', names four forms with no branch and no condition between them: JDF 477 Motion, JDF 492 Order (just do §§ A-C), JDF 493 Notice (Just do §§ A-C), and JDF 478 Order (just do §§ A-C). theSixthJudicialDistrictDefect.provedAtTheSource: Not inferred from the packet. The master-library binary was opened directly and prints 'SIXTH JUDICIAL DISTRICT COURT' at two sites, on the application and on the order. theSixthJudicialDistrictDefect.whyFillingCannotCureIt: VF01 recorded that no widget covers those coordinates in the pinned binary, so the district can be neither set nor cleared by filling the form. theSixthJudicialDistrictDefect.whatTheBuildDoesDoAboutIt: It stops making it worse and it tells the participant. The county blank above the line is empty on both fixtures, and participant-instructions.md carries: 'The county in the caption of Form 4-222 and of the order bound with it. That form prints another district's court name directly below the county line, so a county written there would help compose a caption naming a court that is not yours. Complete the whole of that caption by hand on the copy you file, or use your own district's copy of the form.' That is honest mitigation. It is not a cure, because the page as delivered still names the wrong court.
